# Apple Music

4 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Apple Music catalog metadata: search plus artist, album, and track detail. Catalog data only - no streaming counts, no playlists, no audio.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/apple_music/album - 1 credit (standard)

Get an Apple Music album

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns album metadata: title, artist, artwork, track count, and the Apple Music album URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Apple Music album ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Apple Music album URL. · e.g. `https://music.apple.com/us/album/red-taylors-version/1590368448`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/album?url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/red-taylors-version/1590368448" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_music/artist - 1 credit (standard)

Get an Apple Music artist

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 900s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Author · **Pagination** none

Returns artist metadata: id, name, artwork, and the Apple Music artist URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Apple Music artist ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Apple Music artist URL. · e.g. `https://music.apple.com/us/artist/taylor-swift/159260351`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/artist?url=https://music.apple.com/us/artist/taylor-swift/159260351" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_music/search - 1 credit (standard)

Search Apple Music

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** SearchResult · **Pagination** single page - Fixed-window feed: upstream returns a single non-cursored result set.

Returns Apple Music search results for a query. Pass `type` to restrict the result kind (for example song, album, or artist).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search query. · e.g. `taylor swift`
- `type` (optional, string) - Optional result kind such as song, album, or artist. · e.g. `song`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/search?query=taylor swift" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_music/track - 1 credit (standard)

Get an Apple Music track

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns track metadata: title, artist, duration, preview audio URL, and the Apple Music track URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Apple Music track ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Apple Music track URL. · e.g. `https://music.apple.com/us/album/22-taylors-version/1590368448?i=1590368457`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/track?url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/22-taylors-version/1590368448?i=1590368457" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
